decisions.reason: A newly launched IMU module that is only mentioned on the website has uncertain traction, but one year is too short to judge, and sensor modules usually stay in a small electronics firm's catalog.
The AC voltage input module has its own dedicated page, which signals a committed core industrial I/O product with long lifecycle expectations.
A four-channel solid state relay module fits naturally into an industrial I/O module family, and keeping it costs little.
The server room monitoring kit faces more competition and has a less certain fit, but it is still kept for now as it bundles existing sensors at low ongoing cost.
